The scoring was completed Friday. Priya Anand, a freelancer from a neighboring county whom you have not met, scored 87. Owen Reyes scored 79. Owen spent six years next to you on night shifts, stepped in during the week of your mother's funeral without being asked, and has had no newsroom job since the Herald folded in March. This morning he texted to ask whether he should keep paying for his apartment through the summer. The publisher wants your recommendation at the morning meeting. No one beyond the newsroom sees the score sheet.
